Inside a real SAM feature tensor

· · Saved Feature 3DGS teacher tensor

Real data, approximate displayed values. The original training tensor is loaded from disk by Python. For portable browser visualization, it is quantized to 8 bits per channel. The numeric values and cosine similarity shown here are approximate. This is not an object mask or segmentation output.

1 — Original RGB photograph

This is the real input image, not a synthetic chair.

2 — Select a spatial feature-grid location

Click/drag on this feature-grid to choose (row, column). The selected cell holds one vector with all channels.

3 — Selected 256-D vector

The horizontal axis is feature channel index; vertical values are the decoded approximate tensor values.

4 — Similarity across the feature grid

Blue: more similar · red: less similar. Cosine similarity does not assign class or instance labels.
